The knowledge base is empty — nothing has been indexed yet.

To populate it, use:
  • capy_batch_execute(commands, queries) — run commands, auto-index output, and search in one call
  • capy_fetch_and_index(url) — fetch a URL, index it, then search with capy_search
  • capy_index(content, source) — manually index text content

After indexing, capy_search becomes available for follow-up queries.

Shared MCP server search budget: search call #2/8 in this window. Results limited to 2/query. Untapered calls left: 1; calls before block: 6; resets in 59582 ms (window 60000 ms; taper after 3; block after 8). Batch queries with search(queries: ["q1","q2"]) or use batch_execute.
